cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Don’t Question the Premise
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to ask why the strange situation exists toward what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've taken charge of breakfast. The ghost is waiting at our table; put out a bowl.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is it haunting our kitchen? We're already late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request for a faster breakfast is approved. Give it instant porridge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why feed a dead person? I'm taking the car now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put its porridge in a travel cup and give the ghost the front seat. You're authorized to drop our guest at the cemetery on your way.

reason: Make B's car departure cause explicit portable food and a ride for the waiting ghost, preserving the refusal to discuss why it exists.
